title: Reproduce minimize and isolate bugs
description: Build a deterministic minimal reproducer, remove irrelevant input, and record a regression case before applying a fix.
objectives: Write exact steps that reproduce the failure reliably
Hold environment and input constant while changing one factor
Shrink a failing input without losing the failure
Turn the minimal counterexample into an automated regression test
rubric: I recorded a repeatable failure with its exact input and expected behavior.
I reduced the example while keeping the failure predicate true.
I passed the minimal-case and invalid-input regression tests.
